import json,collections
items=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(answers)==88
for item,answer in zip(items,answers):

 assert answer['answer'] in item['options']
 assert answer['confidence'] in ('high','low')

assert len({r['item_id'] for r in answers})==88
print('Verified count, order, letters:',len(answers))
print(dict(collections.Counter(i['options'][a['answer']] for i,a in zip(items,answers))))
print('Low confidence:',sum(a['confidence']=='low' for a in answers))
